name: rjsplit
caption:
WHAT CHANGED? 🎮🏀 The Knicks traded RJ Barrett home to us 26 games into 2023-24. Same season, different player.

• Knicks, 2023-24: 18.2 PPG on 42.3% shooting (26 games)
• With us, same season: 21.8 PPG on 55.3%, 6.4 RPG, 4.1 APG (32 games)
• Nearly the same shots: 14.9 a game in New York, 15.4 with us
• This season: 20+ points in 8 of our first 10 games, 27 at Milwaukee

Was it coming home, or was it New York? 👇

beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: The Knicks traded RJ Barrett home to us, mid-season. Twenty-six games in. Watch what changed.

beats.head: WITH US

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: And this season? Twenty points or more in eight of our first ten games, including twenty-seven at Milwaukee.

facts.claim: ESPN stats, 2023-24 with the New York Knicks: 26 GP, 18.2 PTS, 42.3 FG%, 14.9 FGA; with the Toronto Raptors: 32 GP, 21.8 PTS, 55.3 FG%, 15.4 FGA, 6.4 REB, 4.1 AST; FG% up 13.0 points (+13) after the trade
On December 30, 2023, the Knicks traded Barrett to the Toronto Raptors; he was born in Toronto
ESPN game log 2026-27: Barrett scored 20 or more points in 8 of Toronto's first 10 games (20+)
